title: HookEvent
description: Normalized cross-harness hook event envelope for telemetry (draft, not wired).

platform.description: Harness or platform that produced the original event.

event.description: Normalized event type (e.g. pre_tool_use, post_tool_use, stop, compact).

session_id.description: Session identifier from the hook payload or environment.

cwd.description: Working directory when the hook fired.

tool.description: Tool name for tool-scoped hook events.

tool_input.description: Normalized tool input payload when available.

tool_output.description: Normalized tool output payload when available.

session.description: Normalized session metadata, including transcript paths when present.

raw.description: Original platform payload retained for adapters that need unmapped fields.
